_source: A trimmed, anonymised copy of a REAL invoice from sanneandersen's live Stripe account, FETCHED on 2026-08-29 on API version 2026-04-22.dahlia. The shape is Stripe's; names and ids are replaced. It is fetched rather than written on purpose: a hand-written imitation confirms the author's understanding of the shape, and a wrong understanding of the shape WAS the bug (F102). The decisive property is that the key `subscription` is ABSENT from the `dahlia` object — not null, absent. The test asserts that against the object itself; this file deliberately carries no field claiming it, because a fixture whose whole value is that nobody wrote it must not carry a fact somebody wrote in it.
